subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should OpenClaw permanently emit an info-level timing record for every Codex dynamic-tool response, or should this instrumentation be opt-in, sampled, or otherwise bounded?
rationale: The patch introduces a durable operational logging behavior rather than only internal test instrumentation; code review cannot safely choose the repository's logging-volume and retention policy.

options.title: Approve bounded permanent telemetry
options.body: Accept one structured record per dynamic-tool response after reviewing live evidence that the event is useful and contains no sensitive payloads.

options.title: Require an opt-in or bounded policy
options.body: Adjust the implementation to use the repository-approved verbosity, sampling, or diagnostics mechanism before merging.

options.title: Keep this investigation-only
options.body: Do not merge permanent runtime logging if the measured latency investigation does not justify an ongoing operator-facing event.

recommendation.title: Require an opt-in or bounded policy
recommendation.body: Adjust the implementation to use the repository-approved verbosity, sampling, or diagnostics mechanism before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership was not attributable from the supplied history context; route to the Codex app-server owner identified by repository history before deciding the permanent log policy.
